churches.assessment: Truth Bible Church is an independent Baptist Bible church in Hollywood, Maryland (Southern Maryland), planted in 2008 and now led by Dr. Joshua West, who holds a Th.M and a Th.D in systematic theology from Trinity College of the Bible and Theological Seminary. Its statement of faith affirms the inerrancy of Scripture, the Trinity, orthodox Christology (virgin birth, physical resurrection, substitutionary atonement), and salvation by grace alone through faith alone, with believer's baptism by immersion. The church is governed by a plurality of male elders (Dr. Joshua West, Dr. Alden Laird, Dr. Dennis Richardson, and Dan Ensminger), with no women in pastoral or elder roles and distinct Men of Truth and Women of Truth ministries, which places it clearly in complementarian practice; discipleship runs through Home Groups and one-to-one counseling, and missions are pursued both locally and through Pastor West's work with the church-planting ministry Compel International. The clearest signal comes from West's own published theology: Hard Sayings: Reconciling the Cost of Discipleship and the American Dream and Come and Die press a costly, counter-consumerist discipleship and openly reject the feel-good preaching that never calls sinners to repentance, while The Power of Preaching and his verse-by-verse Romans volumes point to expository, doctrinally serious preaching. The church website (Wix) is sparse and was mid-transition, but the leadership page, an active Facebook (TBCMaryland) and Instagram presence, and the pastor's substantial public writing together substantiate a green rating rather than a default yellow.
